programme.title: Milenge Milenge
programme.desc: Priya believes she has met her destined lover when she meets and falls in love with Amit, but they soon part ways due to differences. Fate, however, perpetually conspires to bring them back together.

programme.title: Deewaanapan
programme.desc: A country boy falls in love with a rich man's daughter and moves to the city to be with her. However, the girl's father is determined to go to any length to separate the lovers.

programme.title: Farrey
programme.desc: Brought up in an orphanage, child prodigy Niyati gets admitted into a prestigious school. Soon, surrounded by money, she gets engulfed in a cheating racket.

programme.title: Qarib Qarib Singlle
programme.desc: Jaya and Yogi, two contrasting personalities, set out to retrace past relationships, sparking the most eventful trip of their lives.

programme.title: Thappad
programme.desc: Amrita, a young woman, leads a content life with her husband, Vikram. However, their happiness is shattered when he slaps her at an office party, causing her to file for a divorce.

programme.title: Happy Bhaag Jaayegi
programme.desc: On the day of her wedding, Happy, a spirited Indian woman, elopes to marry Guddu, the man she loves. But when she mistakenly arrives at the home of a Pakistani politician, chaos erupts.

programme.title: Kahaani 2
programme.desc: When her disabled daughter is kidnapped, Vidya attempts to save her, but a car knocks her off. When the police get involved in the case, Vidya's mysterious past is revealed.

programme.title: Raazi
programme.desc: As diplomatic tensions rise in 1971, a daring Kashmiri woman walks the tightrope between marriage and duty, delving into the shadows of espionage to protect her motherland.

programme.title: Phata Poster Nikla Hero
programme.desc: Vishwas, the son of a widow, wants to be an actor despite his mother's wish that he become a police inspector. However, his life takes a turn when he gets entangled with a criminal gang.

programme.title: Ghajini
programme.desc: Suffering from memory loss every 15 minutes, a heartbroken man uses photographs, notes and tattoos to keep reminding himself to punish his lady-love's murderer.

programme.title: Vedaa
programme.desc: Vedaa, a victim of caste discrimination, trains as a boxer under Abhimanyu and strives to seek justice for the murder of her siblings.

programme.title: Mr. X
programme.desc: After gaining the power of invisibility, Raghu becomes a vigilante in order to take revenge on those who have wronged him and his lover.

programme.title: Hijack
programme.desc: A maintenance engineer lays his life on the line to save his daughter and other passengers on a plane hijacked by terrorists. He uses the help of an air-hostess in an effort to foil their plan.

programme.title: Crook
programme.desc: After his uncle catches him selling pirated DVDs, Jai Dixit is sent to Australia with a new identity. However, whilst falling in love with a woman, he assumes yet another identity to pursue her.

programme.title: Dil Juunglee
programme.desc: Love blossoms between Koroli and Sumit, two people with contrasting personalities, when the latter joins her English class.

programme.title: Sajini Shinde Ka Viral Video
programme.desc: School teacher Sajini Shinde goes missing after a risqué video of her is leaked on the internet. As the case becomes a public scandal, a police officer searches for the truth.

programme.title: Jeena Sirf Merre Liye
programme.desc: Two friends, Pooja and Karan, get separated after Pooja relocates to the city. As grown-ups, although the two meet, they do not recognise each other and continue to search for one another.

programme.title: Kya Kool Hain Hum 3
programme.desc: A man, kicked out of his house, begins to work as an adult film actor in Thailand. However, things take a turn when he falls in love with a girl from a conservative family.

programme.title: Dhadak
programme.desc: A world of uncertainties awaits Madhu and Parthavi as their love transcends class divides and blossoms despite the fierce disapproval of their families.

programme.title: Race
programme.desc: The relationship between two stepbrothers develops cracks when they fall in love with the same woman. As a result, the younger brother tries to kill the other and inherit the insurance money.

programme.title: Chandu Champion
programme.desc: An extraordinary man confronts relentless challenges with unwavering determination.

programme.title: Murder 2
programme.desc: When a slew of sex workers disappear, Arjun, a former police officer, is brought in to crack the case. Subsequently, as he works undercover with Reshma, a young prostitute, she too disappears.

programme.desc: Raja disguises himself as a married woman to find a rental house for his friends. However, trouble brews when he falls for the landlady's daughter.
